summary: Implemented namespace membership with `in`. In rdflib/namespace.py, Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test, reference as subject). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True when any stored term URI equals the reference under node-type-aware equality; _RDFNamespace inherits it. The closed-namespace _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(str(self.uri)). In test/test_namespace.py I added tests for Namespace prefix membership (positive, proper-prefix negative, self), RDFS membership (defined term True, undefined term sharing base False, plain string and Literal False), and RDF membership (rdf:type True). Nothing was committed. Tests and doctests were NOT run, per the instructions, so the changes are verified by reading only; running test/test_namespace.py and the namespace.py doctests is the remaining step.
